arts.ttl: Vitinha bags hat-trick as PSG blow away Tottenham in eight-goal Champions League thriller
arts.sum: Tottenham were blown away by Paris Saint-Germain in one of the most thrilling Champions League games of the season, with Vitinha bagging a brilliant hat-trick at Parc des Princes on Wednesday.

arts.ttl: Thomas Frank pleased with Tottenham performance despite 5-3 defeat to PSG
arts.sum: Thomas Frank was pleased with the reaction he got from Tottenham despite the 5-3 defeat to PSG in the UEFA Champions League . Vitinha got his second to level it at 2-2 before Fabian Ruiz gave PSG the lead for the first time in the game.

arts.ttl: Vitinha’s hat trick helps PSG rally twice to beat Tottenham 5-3 in Champions League
arts.sum: Following a neat interchange of passes, Archie Gray clipped a cross to the back post and Randal Kolo Muani — who is on loan from PSG this season — nodded the ball across goal to give Brazil forward Richarlison an easy close-range header. PSG then scored in quick succession from Ruiz’s low shot and Pacho’s effort from close range following a corner as Tottenham’s defense cracked for the second time in a matter of days, and the team was beaten for the fourth time in six games.

arts.ttl: Kolo Muani stands out for Tottenham with 2 goals and an assist in 5-3 loss to PSG
arts.sum: The France international had two goals and an assist for Tottenham in a 5-3 loss to PSG in the Champions League on Wednesday. For his second goal, Kolo Muani skipped past two defenders inside the penalty area before drilling a low shot into the bottom left corner in the 73rd to pull the score back to 4-3.

arts.ttl: Spurs show signs of improvement in defeat at PSG
arts.sum: Champions League analyst Stephen Warnock feels Tottenham took some "baby steps" in terms of improvement in their performance during their 5-3 defeat at PSG.

arts.ttl: PSG vs Tottenham Highlights (5-3) – Vitinha strikes twice with absolute screamers!
arts.sum: Paris Saint-Germain delivered a thrilling performance at the Parc des Princes, defeating Tottenham 5-3 in a spectacular Champions League clash on matchday 5 of the 2025-2026 season. arts.ttl: Frank pleased with Spurs' performance despite defeat at PSG
arts.sum: Tottenham Hotspur manager Thomas Frank is pleased with his side's performance despite losing 5-3 to PSG because they responded well after their defeat to Arsenal at the weekend.
